description: This file defines the base form class for handling Contacts in SuiteCRM, including methods for rendering forms, processing saves, and managing duplicate detection.

classes.name: ContactFormBase
classes.description: A base class for handling contact forms, including rendering, validation, duplicate detection, and saving contact data.

methods.name: getDuplicateQuery
methods.description: Generates an SQL query string used to check for duplicate contacts based on first and last name.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Generates HTML form for wide contact form, including address, phone, email, and other details.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Generates a basic contact form HTML for quick entry.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Creates an HTML form for creating or editing a contact record.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submission, validates, handles duplicates, performs save operation, and manages redirects.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Performs redirection after save based on return parameters.

methods.name: getContact
methods.description: Returns a new Contact bean instance.
